trainingGuide.title: Nexo CrossFit: training, community and progress for every level
trainingGuide.intro: Push your limits at Nexo CrossFit, the place where sport becomes fun and commitment turns into lasting well-being. Improve your physical and mental health while joining a motivating, dynamic community in the heart of Valencia. Become part of the Nexo family and discover how to reach your goals step by step with the support of our coaches and your training partners at the box.

onramp.title: Beginner programming: how to start CrossFit in Valencia

paragraphs.0: Our basic course, known as On Ramp, is designed for people approaching CrossFit for the first time. In this guided program, you will learn the fundamental exercise techniques, the importance of correct posture and safe execution patterns to help prevent injuries. During the first weeks, the coach adapts the stimulus to your physical level, allowing you to build confidence before joining regular classes. This gradual approach supports your integration and ensures you can face each WOD with awareness and safety.

Our CrossFit classes last 60 minutes and are designed to balance strength, endurance, flexibility and technique for every athlete. The weekly programming is adapted to your level and progress. In addition to traditional CrossFit, we offer several specialties so you can build complete fitness.

bullets.0: HYROX: improve cardiovascular endurance and prepare for endurance competitions.
bullets.1: Strength: focused work to improve your maximum strength.
bullets.2: Gymnastics: development of gymnastic movement skills and bodyweight control.
bullets.3: Weightlifting: specific Olympic lifting technique, including Snatch, Clean and Jerk.
bullets.4: Adapted programming so every athlete can train with safety, intensity and progression.

paragraphs.0: HYROX workouts combine several disciplines to improve aerobic and anaerobic capacity. They are ideal both for athletes who want to compete in Valencia or nationally and for anyone looking for optimal fitness, better endurance and a demanding but adaptable functional training routine.

whyNexo.title: Why choose Nexo CrossFit in Valencia?

paragraphs.0: At Nexo, you train alongside coaches who care about technique, adapt each session to your level and follow your progress. Our goal is for you to improve consistently, without shortcuts that could compromise your safety or long-term motivation.

bullets.1: Experience in injury prevention and refined technique.
bullets.2: Training in first aid and athletic support.
bullets.3: Motivational ability to support your individual progress.

schedules.title: Variety of classes, schedules and plans

paragraphs.0: Our box offers flexible schedules designed to fit your lifestyle, from early morning to evening. We offer day passes, monthly memberships with discounts for couples or family members, and quarterly, six-month and annual packs with discounts. Signing up is simple, either online or directly at our box in Valencia, where you can meet the team and see the facilities. We also offer a first trial session at a reduced price.

community.title: The Nexo CrossFit community: more than a workout

paragraphs.0: The strength of Nexo CrossFit lies in its community. Here you are not just an athlete, but part of a family. We organize social events, internal competitions, themed workshops and team building sessions. Many of our members say the social side is the key to their consistency. Being part of this family in Valencia means finding motivation and lasting friendships.

We regularly organize group challenges and friendly competitions. These moments are opportunities to test your performance, share goals with other athletes and celebrate team spirit. Follow us on social media to stay up to date with upcoming events at the box.

Nexo CrossFit is located in a strategic area of Valencia, easily accessible by public transport and by car. We also have an indoor area where you can store your bike or scooter. The box has equipped changing rooms, personal lockers and a relaxation area for post-workout recovery.

class.crossfitBullet: CrossFit is a sport that combines strength, endurance and conditioning through functional movements like pushing, lifting, jumping or running. It also integrates disciplines such as gymnastics and weightlifting to develop complete physical fitness.
class.hyroxBullet: HYROX is a training focused on improving cardiovascular endurance and overall fitness, combining running with functional exercises. The sessions prepare for competition formats, but are also designed for anyone looking to improve their fitness.

0.answer: The price of the On Ramp course is 165 euros. It includes all sessions with personalized attention from our coaches.

1.question: Can't make the scheduled time?
1.answer: Don't worry. We offer the option of doing it semi-privately (2 people, 190 € per person) or fully personalized (1 person, 250 €), at the time that suits you best.

0.answer: Daily 60-minute classes. They repeat every hour throughout the day and vary daily. We alternate between strength training and metabolic work (cardio) for a balanced and effective workout.

hyroxGuide.title: Train HYROX in Valencia with running, strength and community
hyroxGuide.intro: At Nexo CrossFit we adapt the sport everyone is talking about to your goals and your current level, whether you want that finisher medal or just want to get into the best shape of your life.

0.title: Training that meets you where you are
0.text: If you are looking for HYROX training in Valencia that mixes cardio endurance with functional strength, you are in the right place. We build sessions where you can adjust the load, intensity and pace, so you can progress safely from your own starting point.

1.title: Running and functional stations
1.text: Our classes bring together the two pillars of HYROX: running and stations like the SkiErg, sleds, weighted lunges and burpees. You train with a strong community around you and certified coaches who help you clean up your technique in every movement.

hyroxFaq.title: Frequently asked questions about our HYROX box
hyroxFaq.description: Here are the questions people ask most before joining HYROX at Nexo, from class length and pricing to whether it is right for beginners.

0.question: Why train HYROX at Nexo CrossFit?
0.answer: Because we combine official-style programming adapted to your level, fully equipped facilities with competition-specific material like sleds, rowers and wall balls, and specialist coaches focused on running efficiency and injury prevention. HYROX is a challenge against yourself, not against everyone else.

1.question: Is it for me if I have never tried it before?
1.answer: Yes, absolutely. HYROX calls itself the fitness competition for every body. You do not need Olympic lifts or acrobatics; we focus on natural body movements and adapt the intensity to your current level.

2.question: How long are HYROX classes?
2.answer: Each session lasts 45 minutes. We structure the class with a dynamic warm-up and a main high-intensity block to work endurance, strength and aerobic capacity.

3.question: How much do HYROX classes cost in Valencia?
3.answer: At Nexo CrossFit we offer flexible pricing options that fit your weekly availability, including class packs and monthly passes. You can check our current price table or fill in the contact form and we will help you choose the option that fits your goals.

4.question: Is the trial class free?
4.answer: Your first HYROX class costs 10 euros, but if you join us afterwards, we take it off your first monthly fee. That way you can see the box, feel the community and try the training flow before deciding.

5.question: Do I need to compete to join the classes?
5.answer: Not at all. Some athletes train for HYROX Valencia, but most people come to improve their engine, burn fat, build strength and switch off from daily stress. You set the goal.

about.heroSubtitle: Your place to grow with dedication and community.
about.spaceDescription1: This is much more than a gym: it is a box where you will find a genuine community. A place where you will train, improve every day and adopt a lifestyle based on constant self-improvement, enjoying every step of the process.
about.spaceDescription2: Our facilities of over 500 m² offer spacious areas equipped with cutting-edge technology, Concept machines and all the resources you need for your training. We have areas specialized in CrossFit and HYROX, designed so that each session represents a challenge that pushes you to surpass your own limits.
about.philosophyMobile: Our methodology is based on physiological and biomechanical knowledge and also focuses on working with a spirit that seeks to move away from the senseless egos that surround the fitness world.
about.philosophyGym: For this reason, gymnastics exercises are one of the pillars in our daily work. We use them to build the foundation for more complex movements.
about.philosophyDesktop: Our methodology is based on physiological and biomechanical knowledge and also focuses on working with a spirit that seeks to move away from the senseless egos that surround the fitness world. For this reason, gymnastics exercises are one of the pillars in our daily work. We use them to build the foundation for more complex movements.
about.philosophyQuote: "MORE IS NOT BETTER, BETTER IS BETTER"
about.historyDescription1: Since we opened in 2017 and to this day, at Nexo we like to define ourselves as the space where the desire to learn and improve, interacts with the capacity for effort. All of this, in an environment that is not only respectful, but fosters lasting bonds of friendship.
about.historyDescription2: We don't want to be just another CrossFit box. We have adapted our way of planning and understanding training so that, if you trust us, we can accompany you in your improvement process for a long time.

zoltan.desc0: Years ago I left my previous profession to dedicate myself to what I discovered in 2014: CrossFit. Not as a hobby, but as a lifestyle. Something as necessary for me as eating or sleeping, both training and teaching.
zoltan.desc1: Together with my team, we work to transform lives. Every person who walks through our doors receives physical and mental attention, because we know that change goes beyond training.
zoltan.desc2: Nexo represents me completely. Every detail is taken care of with precision and passion. Behind it is a team based on humility, that understands this is not about us, it's about you.

alan.desc0: I started CrossFit in 2017. For me CrossFit is not just a sport, it's discipline, community and self-improvement. I started helping in classes whenever I could, and that's when I discovered I wanted to dedicate myself to this: spreading the same motivation that brought me here. Years later I started artistic gymnastics to improve my gymnastics skills. That's where I met Zoltan, who introduced me to Nexo and its methodology, and I knew from day one it was my place. A place where I can keep growing as a coach and as an athlete.

dilian.desc0: I always did sports, but at some point I lost motivation. Someone recommended CrossFit and from the first class I knew it was my place.
dilian.desc1: I got hooked on the variety and mix of disciplines. But when I got to know Nexo I understood that what I knew was only a small part of what CrossFit really is. I never thought about becoming a coach, but when something is your passion, you want to share it.
dilian.desc2: Today I know this is what I want to do: learn, improve and help others to do the same.
dilian.desc3: See you at the box to keep growing, improving every day and, above all, having fun.

toni.desc0: Passion for what I do and curiosity to understand the why. These two things have taken me through the fitness world for over ten years, through various certifications and training models.
toni.desc1: I've done sports all my life. Individual sports, team sports, anything. With one goal: to move better every time and enjoy it.
toni.desc2: In the recent years I was working to be a firefighter, and learned to combine that role with coaching, trying to get the best of both worlds.
toni.desc3: A few years ago I arrived at Nexo CrossFit, and here I've been able to keep growing professionally and athletically. But what I value the most is the bond with teammates and athletes.
toni.desc4: I guess that's why it's called "Nexo" (connection).

javi.desc0: Graduated in physiotherapy and specialized in sports physiotherapy (Master's in sports physiotherapy and physical preparation in football). With extensive experience both in the professional field (Levante UD) and in sports in general here at Nexo CrossFit.
javi.desc1: Physiotherapy and exercise will go hand in hand for the prevention, rehabilitation and treatment of typical sports ailments or injuries, so you never stop moving.

privacy.intro: At NEXO CrossFit (TURIA BOX SOCIEDAD LIMITADA), we are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This policy describes how we collect, use and protect the information you provide through our website and forms.
privacy.responsibleText: TURIA BOX SOCIEDAD LIMITADA is the entity responsible for processing your personal data. You can contact us at info@nexocrossfit.es or at our address: Arzobispo Fabián y Fuero, 21. Valencia, 46009.
privacy.dataCollectedText: Through our contact forms, trial class bookings and On Ramp course registration, we may collect the following data:

privacy.legalBasisText: The processing of your data is based on your explicit consent, given by accepting this privacy policy in our forms, as well as on the execution of the sports service contract.

privacy.securityText: We adopt the necessary technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure or destruction.
privacy.cookiesText: Our website uses technical and functional cookies necessary for the proper functioning of the site. These cookies do not collect personally identifiable information. We do not use third-party tracking or advertising cookies.
privacy.changesText: We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy at any time. Any changes will be published on this page with the date of the last update.
